final: WITH linked_executions AS (SELECT o.orderbase, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM linked_executions) SELECT le.orderbase AS channel, AVG(le.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS execution_fraction FROM linked_executions AS le CROSS JOIN totals GROUP BY le.orderbase ORDER BY le.orderbase
